token_near_graduation.meaning: the LaunchToken is near reaching BONDING_SUPPLY graduation

pair_deployed_before_graduation.meaning: the (token, quote) UniSwapV2 pair was deployed before graduation

pair_token_reserve_wei.meaning: internal reserve of tokenA in the pair after the attacker's direct deposit and sync

token_transferable_before_graduation.meaning: LaunchToken can be transferred before graduation (report states it cannot; only launchpad and GTE router may move tokens and _assertValidRecipient prevents the pair as final recipient)

assumptions: The attacker is an unprivileged caller able to deploy the pair and deposit 1 wei before graduation.
The 1 wei deposit and sync occur before the graduation buy reaches BONDING_SUPPLY.
The intended graduation deposits 20% of the token and all held quoteReserve into the pool without reverting.

unresolved.description: The selected impact i_no_token_transfer_before_graduation is a transfer-restriction property (tokens cannot move until graduation; only launchpad/GTE router may move them; _assertValidRecipient blocks the pair as final recipient), which is not the graduation-completion relation asserted by the security intent; the report does not connect this transfer restriction to the graduation success obligation, so the impact cannot be faithfully bound to this intent's relation.

limitations: Only the transfer-restriction impact is formalized here; the graduation-DoS impact i_graduation_permanently_disabled is handled in a separate pass.
The 20% token / all quoteReserve deposit amounts are intended logic, not observed values, and are not encoded.
The report does not establish whether the attacker is permissionless; the assumption records this.
